name: Facet
text: Choose a system-aware default dark theme with a manual light-mode toggle. This maximizes visibility and liveliness in low-light environments while giving users control—matching the competitive analysis findings and the Graphify Dashboard’s proven approach. The trade-off is a slight delay in initial load time to detect system preferences, but that’s outweighed by the immediate usability benefit for the majority of users who prefer dark mode.

name: Pane
text: The real risk isn’t user preference—it’s locking ourselves into a theme system before proving users *need* it. A better alternative: start with a single, high-contrast dark theme and add a light-mode toggle only if user feedback demands it. Settle this with a quick A/B test—track engagement metrics in dark vs. light mode over two weeks.
